message.content:
Here’s a classic recipe for lasagna:

**Ingredients**

| Category | Item | Quantity |
|----------|------|----------|
| **Lasagna sheets** | Fresh or dried lasagna noodles | 12–15 sheets (or one box of no-boil noodles) |
| **Meat sauce** | Ground beef (or a mix of beef & pork) | 1 lb (450 g) |
| | Onion, finely chopped | 1 medium |
| | Garlic cloves, minced | 2–3 |
| | Crushed tomatoes or tomato sauce | 28 oz (800 g) can |
| | Tomato paste | 2 Tbsp |
| | Olive oil | 2 Tbsp |
| | Salt | 1 tsp |
| | Black pepper | ½ tsp |
| | Dried oregano | 1 tsp |
| | Dried basil | 1 tsp |
| | Red pepper flakes (optional) | ¼ tsp |
| | Sugar (to balance acidity) | 1 tsp |
| | Fresh parsley or basil, chopped (optional) | 2 Tbsp |
| **Ricotta mixture** | Ricotta cheese | 15 oz (425 g) |
| | Egg (beaten) | 1 |
| | Grated Parmesan cheese | ½ cup (50 g) |
| | Salt | ½ tsp |
| | Black pepper | ¼ tsp |
| | Fresh parsley or basil, chopped | 2 Tbsp |
| **Bechamel sauce** | Butter | 4 Tbsp |
| | All-purpose flour | 4 Tbsp |
| | Milk (whole or 2%) | 4 cups (960 ml) |
| | Nutmeg (freshly grated) | pinch |
| | Salt | ½ tsp |
| | Black pepper | ¼ tsp |
| **Cheese topping** | Shredded mozzarella cheese | 2 cups (200 g) |
| | Grated Parmesan cheese | ½ cup (50 g) |
| | Optional: shredded provolone or fontina | ½ cup (50 g) |

**Optional extras**

- Sautéed spinach or kale (about 2 cups) mixed into the ricotta layer.
- Cooked mushrooms (sliced) added to the meat sauce.
- A splash of red wine in the meat sauce for depth.

With these ingredients you’ll have everything you need to assemble a hearty, layered lasagna. Enjoy!
